events.text: The first snow of the year falls overnight. The whole town is quiet and white.

effects.log: Cold feet, clear head.

choices.text: Build a snow lion for the children

effects.log: It guards the street until spring.

events.text: Spring meltwater floods the lower streets. Families carry their furniture onto the roofs.

effects.log: A long wet day. Many thanks.
Sensible. You watch the water go down by evening.

events.text: A heatwave. Even the dogs lie flat in the shade and refuse to move.

effects.log: Smart. You stay strong and cool.

choices.text: Train at noon to toughen up

effects.log: You faint in the courtyard.

events.text: The maples turn red on the hillsides. Travellers come from far away just to look.

effects.log: Red leaves, blue sky, quiet heart.
A good autumn. (+5 taels)

events.text: A great thunderstorm rolls in. Lightning strikes the tallest tree on the hill.

choices.text: Go and look at the tree

effects.log: Split in two, smoking. You keep a piece of the lightning wood.
Thunder like drums of heaven.

events.text: No rain for two months. The wells are low and tempers are short.

effects.log: Water at last. The village celebrates.
You are thirsty; your neighbours are not.

events.text: A cloud of locusts darkens the sky and lands on the fields.

choices.text: Help beat them off with sticks

effects.log: A hopeless, noble day.
Crunchy. Salty. Revenge.

events.text: A fog so thick you cannot see your own hand.

effects.log: Your ears and skin learn to see.
You bump into a cow. Twice.

events.text: After rain, a double rainbow arches over the river.

effects.log: Nobody knows if it works.
The colours run. It is still beautiful.

events.text: The coldest winter in memory. The river freezes solid enough for carts.

effects.log: Faster than any ferry.

choices.text: Chop firewood for the old people

effects.log: Warm houses, warm hearts.

events.text: Spring ploughing. The farmers' oxen are sick and the fields must be turned.

effects.log: The farmers are amazed. Your back is not.
Some herbs, some patience, healthy oxen.

events.text: A hot summer afternoon. The river is cool and the children are swimming.

effects.log: You race the children and lose on purpose.
Two fish and a nap.

events.text: The harvest moon is huge and orange over the fields.

effects.log: Moonlight fills your meridians.
Everyone brings something.

events.text: The ground shakes. Roof tiles fall and dogs howl.

choices.text: Shield a child under a table

effects.log: You are both unhurt.

events.text: The rains turn every road into a river of mud.

effects.log: Your boots never recover.

choices.text: Wait for the roads to dry

effects.log: A week of reading by the window.

events.text: The blossoms fall like snow in the temple courtyard.

choices.text: Sit under the tree all day

effects.log: Petals in your tea, in your hair, in your heart.
Every poet has written this poem. Yours is still yours.

events.text: A great wind rips roofs off half the town.

effects.log: A week on ladders. Every house is dry again.
Your roof stays. Some do not.

events.text: Hailstones the size of quail eggs smash the melon crop.

choices.text: Help save what melons you can

effects.log: The farmers give you the cracked ones. Delicious.
A bruised forearm, nothing worse.

events.text: The longest night of the year. Families eat dumplings together.

effects.log: Yours are ugly. They taste fine.
The dark is long; your qi is longer.

events.text: A summer night full of fireflies in the rice paddies.

choices.text: Catch one and let it go

effects.log: A small light in your hands.

choices.text: Lie in the grass and watch

effects.log: The stars came down to play.

events.text: The winter market sells roasted sweet potatoes and candied hawthorn.

effects.log: Warm hands, sweet mouth. (−1 taels)

choices.text: Help an old seller push her cart

effects.log: She gives you a free potato.

events.text: The mountains are wrapped in mist for a week. Sounds carry strangely.

effects.log: Above it, the peaks float like islands.
Quiet days, good sleep.

events.text: Rumours of sickness in the next county. People buy every herb in the market.

choices.text: Share your herbs with the poor

effects.log: You go without. Nobody on your street falls ill.
The rumour was only a rumour.

events.text: A whole day of gentle rain. Nothing to do but listen.

effects.log: The best nap of your life.
Rain makes old words new.

events.text: Spring cleaning. You find things you forgot you owned.

effects.log: Some of it was not junk. (+4 taels)
Your house is lighter. So are you.
